status: UNSELECTED PROJECT CHOICE; computable conditional upper-current class only. Physical qualification NOT RUN #65. No supplier or availability claim.
source_wire: Existing ten-board Alpha Wire 5859 AWG14, 19 strands of nominal 27 AWG. Eighteen is the load-wire count, not its gauge.

main_strand_class.wire_accounting: The <=4 mm fan includes its 0.1 mm redistribution tip and lies inside 125 mm total wire length. Its uniform copper baseline must fit 13 mOhm/m. Add transported-core bending energy and tip redistribution above the straight baseline, solder energy and actual interfaces to the existing combined 0.2 mOhm termination allowance.
main_strand_class.current_trial: Nineteen contained strand-core fields carry 1/19 of total current each, with finite tip redistribution to nineteen solder prisms. This is an admissible trial for a circuit terminal with fixed total current; physical current density need not be uniform.
remaining_qualification: Minimum finished core diameter, finite nonoverlapping fan geometry/curvature and actual external terminal scope; nominal AWG alone is not a tolerance guarantee.
Actual continuous solder coverage, <=0.05 mm transfer height, hot resistivity ceiling and positive remaining metallurgical/interface resistance allowance at both ends.
Native support containment outside every drill/collar plus wire retention, solder wicking, strain relief and mechanical envelope.

Existing full 4 x 4 mm land solder-coverage requirement remains. Extra solder is passive conductor: the current trial may omit it, but a primal lower bound must extend continuously through it or constrain the full actual contact support.
This proposal supplies no physical lower-conductivity envelope or completed whole-board resistance/current acceptance.
main_strand_class.maximum_wetted_copper_support: The actual 4 x 4 mm B.Cu AGND land and its owned array foil/barrel copper only. Solder outside that projected land may cover insulation but must not contact additional copper. No wetted support is inferred from the minimum nineteen squares.
main_strand_class.paired_potential_trial: Constrain the entire allowed wetted land and all ports of every intersected owned array barrel to one trial potential; extend that constant through all possible contact metal. This is a restricted continuous variational witness, not an assertion that the physical PCB land is equipotential.
main_strand_class.terminal_boundary_status: OPEN: the external terminal voltage boundary and finite lead extent must be selected consistently for the paired model. Nineteen uniform trial supports alone do not qualify an equipotential wire cut.

GH_class.status: NOT SELECTED; finite external lead-foot contact and potential extension still required
GH_class.primary_nominal_reference: JST America public eGH-new.pdf top-entry drawing shows 0.2 mm nominal lead width and 0.7 mm projection, not a guaranteed minimum contact rectangle. BM03/BM08 land size does not prove a 0.25 mm square metal foot.
GH_class.limits: Regional catalog revision/applicability differs from retained current JST catalog. Do not transfer its temperature range or invent a foot tolerance/hot conductivity guarantee.
